contract.formula: y=silu(x)*b; FP32 SiLU and multiply, final FP32 store
contract.input_generation: CPU fp32 torch.Generator seed20261020+case_index, x[M,N] then b[M,N]; actual rounded CPU inputs used by independent CPUfp64 reference

frozen_plan.selection: Source-driven FFN widths and native gate below/above transition; frozen before timing; old100shape grid unchanged

contract.paired_comparison: A5 must use this exact new shape plan/seed and FP32 contract. Do not compare different old/new shapes by matching case_index.
contract.native_tuning: No autotuner on these original JIT kernels. Preserve native dispatcher and calculate_settings/_swiglu_tile_settings; do not invent an autotune/B200 claim for row path.
contract.baseline: Exact pinned Liger native Blackwell tiled path only on eligible shapes; native row path otherwise; performance untested
contract.precision: All inputs/output FP32; source silu.cast(b.dtype) is an identity FP32 cast; FP16/FP8 explicitly excluded because their intermediate rounding changes the contract
contract.timed_scope: One original Triton forward kernel into preallocated C. Input generation, CPU references, allocation, descriptor/shape decisions and device transfer outside fn; no native Torch GPU compute/backward
contract.mutation: Inputs read-only; output overwritten each invocation
contract.candidate_status: UNRUN: no compile, correctness, timing or optimality claims
